title: entityViewSections
responsibility: Selects the existing entity sections for its visual and headless presentation context.

inputs.name: entityViewSections.context
inputs.description: Entity category context; its entity and category getters are read only for the APIs section, after the existing headless and visual checks.

inputs.name: entityViewSections.headless
inputs.description: Whether this entity uses a plan instead of designs; supplied from the existing owner state.

inputs.name: entityViewSections.visual
inputs.description: Whether this entity uses States instead of Evidence; supplied from the existing owner state.

outputs.name: entityViewSections
outputs.description: A fresh list in canonical section order, preserving existing feature and category exclusions. No context or section table is changed.

errors.name: Context access failure
errors.description: Errors from supplied entity/category getters or proxy traps propagate unchanged.
